answer: In this PoA network, each agent’s reputation decays exponentially with a defined half-life, so influence requires sustained, honestly verified service rather than a brief burst of activity. EigenTrust factorization, adjusted for temporal decay and reciprocity-weighted transitivity, assigns freshly spawned Sybil identities near-zero eigenvector centrality; lacking trusted paths, they cannot propagate nectar, wharf, or meadow endorsements into a consensus-passing score.
